gloss: to fit; to insert; to put on (ring)

definitions.explanation: To put something into a frame, slot, or opening so it fits precisely.
To put jewelry or accessories on one's fingers or hands.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}にガラスを{嵌|は}めた。
examples.english: I fitted glass into the window.

examples.japanese: {指輪|ゆびわ}を{嵌|は}めている。
{彼|かれ}は{誰|だれ}かに{嵌|は}められたようだ。
examples.english: It seems he was set up by someone.

examples.japanese: {蓋|ふた}を{嵌|は}めてください。
{枠|わく}に{写真|しゃしん}を{嵌|は}める。
examples.english: Fit a photo in the frame.

examples.japanese: パズルのピースを{嵌|は}める。
ドアに{鍵|かぎ}を{嵌|は}めた。
examples.english: I fitted a lock on the door.

examples.japanese: {手袋|てぶくろ}を{嵌|は}めて{作業|さぎょう}する。
{婚約|こんやく}{指輪|ゆびわ}を{嵌|は}めた。
examples.english: I put on the engagement ring.

examples.japanese: {腕時計|うでどけい}を{嵌|は}める。
ゴム{手袋|てぶくろ}を{嵌|は}めている。
{罠|わな}に{嵌|は}めようとした。

examples.english: I was tricked by a scam.

examples.japanese: {同僚|どうりょう}に{嵌|は}められて{解雇|かいこ}された。
examples.english: I was framed by a colleague and fired.

examples.japanese: {見事|みごと}に{嵌|は}められた。

notes:
{嵌|は}める is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) with meanings ranging from fitting things to trapping people.

INTRANSITIVE PAIR: {嵌|は}まる (to fit into, to be stuck)
- {嵌|は}める: I fit the glass in.
- {嵌|は}まる: The glass fits in.

ASPECT (ている):
{嵌|は}めている indicates something is fitted/worn, or someone has been set up.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]を[opening]に{嵌|は}める — to fit [thing] into [opening]
- [ring/gloves]を{嵌|は}める — to put on [ring/gloves]
- [person]を{嵌|は}める — to trap/set up [person]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {指輪|ゆびわ}を{嵌|は}める (put on a ring)
- {手袋|てぶくろ}を{嵌|は}める (put on gloves)
- {罠|わな}に{嵌|は}める (trap someone)

OFTEN IN HIRAGANA:
This verb is frequently written as はめる due to the kanji's rarity.

COLLOQUIAL USE:
{嵌|は}められた (I was set up!) is common in casual speech when claiming to have been tricked or framed.
